recap.text: Carl drinks the first of Bravvo's nine Levitation potions with Samantha loaded face down in the xistera and elf hunters walking gas-filled rocks across the town. A slider appears, his feet rise a foot, and he realises he has drunk it in the wrong order. In a freezing downpour, he drinks another and pushes the slider up through the trees to see Miriam Dom's sparks. Something screeching slams him, the levitation snaps off, and he pinwheels down.

Carl, facing a park several blocks wide and full of red dots that Sister Ines says are all undead, drinks one of his dwindling levitate potions to see it from above. The fog hides everything below, but he can see the dots wandering aimlessly, which lends support to Donut's zombie theory. The spire at the centre of the square is a Club Vanquisher.

Carl hears the last messages from Toyotomi and Bomo and stops thinking. He runs past Juice Box and the Semeru dwarves, punches a zarogoth away at the railing, and drinks the final Levitation potion while dozens of arms reach for him. It carries him straight up and out of Larracos, still a good hundred metres short of the edge of Shanty Town, and he drops a whole folder of bombs toward the Piccadilly.

beats.headline: Nine off a dead hunter
beats.text: The hunter Bravvo was using one of these to scout Point Mongo when he caught a missile to the face. Hunters carry slots, not bottomless inventories, so his loot is thin: thirty good health potions, thirty good mana refills, a longsword for the sell pile, clothes, and his naked corpse. The only real prize is a set of nine potions of Levitation. Not as good as flying potions, they let the drinker rise into the air for intelligence times two seconds. It is not clear how high one can go, or what happens if the potion runs out before you have lowered yourself.
beats.gist: Carl finds nine Levitation potions on the dead hunter Bravvo, each lifting the drinker briefly.

beats.headline: Up and down on a slider
beats.text: Two or three elf hunters have set up a catapult and are walking gas-filled rocks across the town, and Carl has Samantha loaded face down in the xistera. He drinks the first potion. A slider appears in his interface, up and down only, with a sixty-second countdown, and he realises he has done this in the wrong order. His feet rise a foot, and tapping the air feels like standing on glass. Mordecai has stressed how dangerous these are: momentum will still drop you, so they are no substitute for feather fall unless taken before the jump. Treat it like thin ice. Carl hovers, waiting out his potion timer.
beats.gist: Carl drinks the potion, rises a foot, and hovers through its sixty-second countdown.

beats.headline: Knocked out of the sky
beats.text: In a freezing downpour, Carl needs to see the sparks Miriam Dom is shooting into the air. He downs one of the potions of Levitation and pushes the slider up through the trees, his cloak billowing. Far behind him the night glows with a big fire, and he reckons Donut has set the whole forest aflame. The sparks show two kilometres south. Then a screeching, frothing form slams into him from the side, the levitation snaps off at once, and he pinwheels down out of the sky until he freezes in midair to pounding EDM music.
beats.gist: Carl drinks a Levitation potion to find Miriam Dom's sparks, but something slams him from the side.

beats.headline: A look over the fog
beats.text: The park ahead is several blocks wide and full of red dots, and Sister Ines says every one of them is undead. Carl uses one of his dwindling supply of levitate potions to get a better view from above. The roiling fog hides everything, but from that height he can see the dots wandering aimlessly, which lends weight to Donut's zombie theory, and the spire at the centre of the square is a familiar one: a Club Vanquisher.
beats.gist: Carl drinks a levitation potion to see over the fog and spots a Club Vanquisher spire.

beats.headline: The last one
beats.text: The final messages from Toyotomi and Bomo come in, and Carl does not think. He runs past Juice Box and the Semeru dwarves, punches a zarogoth out of the way at the railing, and drinks the final Levitation potion in his inventory as dozens of arms reach for him. He shoots straight up, pushing it to the limit, and its apex carries him up and out of Larracos, still a good hundred metres short of the edge of Shanty Town. Instead of aiming, he drops an entire inventory folder of bombs toward the Piccadilly.
beats.gist: Carl drinks his last Levitation potion and rockets up out of Larracos, short of Shanty Town's edge.
